findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-001, which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email address, and phone number before creating a Member account.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-011, which holds reserved items on the pickup shelf for exactly 72 hours before automatically canceling the hold and notifying the next Member in queue.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses chained "and/or" connectives, making it unclear which combination of the three actions must be executed.

findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or system component reviews, approves, and records overdue fine waiver requests.

findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-019, which sets the overdue fine at $0.50 USD per overdue day per item capped at a maximum of $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-020, which blocks any Member with an unpaid fine balance exceeding $5.00 USD from borrowing or renewing items.

findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-003, which mandates irreversible bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
